description:
Reiji, the latest rookie of the Bureau of Espionage`s Black Torch squad, hails from another famous family of espionage, the Kiriharas, and is an expert in his ancestral style of sword fighting by the same name. Calm and collected, Reiji lives and breathes rationality. Still, that isn`t enough for Reiji to keep his cool when crossing paths with the emotionally hot-headed Jirou. Behind his gentlemanly demure disposition, Reiji holds a nearly unshakable pride and readiness for whatever life and battle hurls his way.
Source: Official page
name: Kirihara Reiji
